description: Curated donor age records of the six native-intestine studies, one row per study part (stage, low and high age with units, age convention, source text)
upstream: Curated by hand from the public sample records (ArrayExpress SDRF, GEO) and the papers' methods; no computation.

description: Curated role table of the 16 studies: context, donor ages, and for Figures 2-5 the panels each study appears in and its role there (train, test, split, shown)
upstream: Curated by hand from the final Figure 2-5 panel inputs (which studies each panel uses, and whether as training, held-out test or display); no computation. The McCauley 2023 age is the 20 weeks in vivo recorded for all three GEO GSE214852 samples.

description: Per-study display embedding of 140,805 endocrine cells with primary study labels: study, context, sample, primary label, mapped class, UMAP coordinates and log-normalized TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1, CHGA, FEV, LMX1A, INS, GCG, SST
upstream: Per study, from the labeled endocrine cells' raw counts: Seurat vst 2000 variable genes, log-normalization, scaling, 20 principal components, Harmony across samples (theta 2, lambda 1, sigma 0.1), then UMAP (uwot, cosine, 30 neighbors, min_dist 0.3, 500 epochs, seed 42); display only.

description: Figure 2 label-free four-marker EC classifier calls per cell of the fitting studies (cell_key, presentation_class and fit details)
upstream: Output of the Figure 2 fit of the label-free four-marker EC classifier (EC_CORE score cut-off plus neighborhood consistency) on the primary intestinal fitting studies' raw counts.

description: Raw and SoupX-corrected counts of TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1 (and INS, GCG, SST, CHGA) for every SC-islet cell with a primary study label
upstream: SoupX 1.6.2 per channel on the raw droplet matrices (soup from 1-100 UMI barcodes, clusters = primary study labels, autoEstCont then adjustCounts), keeping the corrected counts of these genes per labeled cell.

description: Raw and SoupX-corrected counts of TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1 and islet hormones for the intestinal, induced and HIO EC cells, per capture, with whether the capture was corrected
upstream: SoupX 1.6.2 per capture on the raw droplet matrices of Elmentaite 2020 + 2021, Egozi 2021, Hickey 2023 (Dryad raw counts), Singh 2024 and McCauley 2023 (soup from empty droplets, clusters = every labeled cell of the capture), keeping these genes for EC cells.

description: As gut_ec_soupx_serotonin_genes, for the native-intestine other EEC cells of the same captures
upstream: Same SoupX runs as gut_ec_soupx_serotonin_genes, keeping the native-intestine 'Other EEC' cells (Crohn's disease donors out).

description: Raw and SoupX-corrected counts of TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1 (and INS, GCG, SST, CHGA) for every adult islet endocrine cell with a primary study label, except the 208 cells of the one capture SoupX could not correct
upstream: SoupX 1.6.2 per capture on the raw droplet matrices of Fasolino 2022 and Bandesh 2026 (soup from 1-100 UMI barcodes, clusters = primary study labels of the labeled endocrine cells, autoEstCont then adjustCounts), keeping the corrected counts of these genes per labeled cell.
